exposure.needed: whether external monitoring (dashboards, alerts, recording rules) queries the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time

consequence.statement: The metric is now exposed as envoy_cilium_npds_update_time rather than envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time, so queries that use the old name stop matching.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules to use envoy_cilium_npds_update_time.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time is renamed to envoy_cilium_npds_update_time, so monitoring that queries the old name has to be updated.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The subject is a Prometheus metric name, and no subject family (crd-field, helm-value, config-key, protocol-behavior, ...) is meant for metric names.; change: The evidence states a rename (old -> new metric name). But the 'renamed' type requires a replacedBy in the same family, and no family can express a metric name.
